fullDescription: A premium electric-dark developer-tool SaaS landing page for an AI design agent: obsidian near-black surfaces lit by a single acid-green accent, a sticky glass nav, terminal/code mock hero, logo cloud, workflow code panel, 3-column feature grid, alternating product shot, 3-tier pricing, glowing CTA band, and a mega footer.

structured.summary: A premium electric-dark developer-tool SaaS landing page for an AI design agent: an obsidian near-black canvas lit by a single acid-green accent, a sticky glass nav, a code/terminal mock hero, a logo cloud, a workflow code panel with surface tabs, a 3-column line-icon feature grid, an alternating product-shot section, a 3-tier pricing block, a glowing CTA band, and a mega footer.

style.description: Electric-dark dev-tool aesthetic: obsidian near-black surfaces, one acid-green accent used as glow, faint grain texture, monospace code framing, terminal traffic-light syntax color. Premium, engineered, never generic.
style.prompt: Dark developer-tool palette on an obsidian base (page #0a0a0f) with layered near-black surfaces: panel #14141b, panel2 #1b1b24, and a hairline border color #26262f used for every divider and card edge. Panels use a subtle 180deg gradient from #16161e to #101015. ONE accent: acid green #22e584 (darker #13c46d), applied as the primary button fill (with dark #06120b label text), glowing rings, eyebrow text, icon color, and gradient-text headline words. Acid is reinforced with glow shadows: a soft 0 0 24px rgba(34,229,132,.55) for small glows, and a button shadow combining a 1px acid ring with a 28px green drop. Text scale is zinc neutrals: zinc1 #fafafa for headings, zinc2 #a1a1aa for body, zinc3 #71717a for muted lines, zinc4 #52525b for the faintest captions. Code blocks use a terminal syntax palette: keyword/acid #22e584, string #d6c98a, number #7aa2ff, comment #8b8b97, function #c4c4cf, punctuation #6b6b78, with macOS traffic-light dots #ff5f57 / #febc2e / #28c840. Fonts via Google Fonts: Space Grotesk (display, 400-700) for the wordmark and all headings with tight tracking (-0.02em to -0.03em); Inter (body, 400-700) for paragraphs; JetBrains Mono (400-600) for code, eyebrows, pills, and captions. Texture: a faint white radial-dot grain (22px grid, ~4% white) over hero and CTA, plus acid radial hero-glow washes in the corners. Selection highlight is acid-tinted. Mood: high-craft, luminous-on-dark, engineered. Keep the accent strictly acid-green, never indigo/violet/blue.

layout_and_structure.description: A long single-column landing page, content centered in a ~1180px max-width container with px-6 gutters and faint vertical guide lines. Sections stack: sticky nav, hero (split copy + code panel), logo cloud, workflow code section, feature grid, alternating product shot, pricing, CTA band, mega footer. Each section is separated by a 1px #26262f hairline.

prompts.prompt: A fixed top header, full-width, with a translucent obsidian bg (bg-obsidian/70) and backdrop-blur-xl, a bottom hairline border, and a 64px-tall row inside the 1180px container. Left: a diamond-glyph logo tile (acid/10 fill, acid/40 ring, small glow) + 'Forge' wordmark in Space Grotesk 700. Center (lg+ only): a pill nav of text links (Features, Library, Workflow, Pricing, Docs with an up-right arrow) that get a faint white hover bg. Right: a ghost 'Sign in' link and a solid acid 'Start building' button.

A two-column hero (lg:grid 1.05fr / 1fr) with acid radial hero-glow and grain behind it, plus faint vertical guide lines at the container edges. Left column: a rounded 'NEW' badge pill (mono) linking to a v2 feature, a huge Space Grotesk 700 headline 'Production UI,' on one line and 'generated.' on the next as acid gradient-text with a glow, a ~440px body paragraph in zinc2, a button row (solid acid 'Start building free' + outlined 'Read the docs' with a book icon), and a mono trust row with two acid check-circle items (No card required / 50 free generations). Right column: a code/terminal mock card.

A rounded-xl panel-gradient card with a #26262f border, a big soft acid blur halo behind it, and a panel shadow. Titlebar: three macOS traffic-light dots (red/amber/green), a centered mono label 'forge generate' with a terminal icon, and a copy icon. Body (mono, 12.5px, line-height 1.85): a shell prompt line with an acid '$' running 'forge gen "pricing page, dark, 3 tiers"', a 'drafting on canvas ...' line, then a nested inset code block on obsidian with syntax-colored generated React (a // comment, an import, an export const Pricing arrow returning a <Grid cols=3> of three <Tier> rows), and a result row with an acid '✓ done' pill plus '3 components · 0.8s · synced to canvas'.

A bordered band (border-y, obsidian bg) with a centered uppercase mono eyebrow 'Shipped to production by teams at', then a horizontally edge-faded (mask gradient) row of ~7 fictional company lockups, each a line/bold icon + a Space-Grotesk-or-mono wordmark in zinc2 that brightens on hover.

A centered-header section with an acid mono eyebrow '// workflow', a Space Grotesk headline 'Ship a screen this afternoon.' (last two words acid gradient-text), and a supporting paragraph. Below: a centered row of surface 'tabs' (Canvas active with acid border + glow, then Claude Code, Cursor, React, Vue, Figma as inactive outlined chips with line icons). Then a centered max-w-3xl big code panel.

A rounded-xl panel-gradient card. Titlebar: an acid 'skill' chip + mono filename 'superdesign-canvas.ts', and expand/copy icons. Body is a two-column grid: a 44px gutter of muted line numbers 1-12 with a right hairline over an obsidian/40 bg, beside syntax-highlighted TypeScript (import { forge } from '@forge/agent', a // comment, a const design = await forge.generate({ ... }) call with prompt/style/tokens/export keys, and design.openOnCanvas() with a // infinite canvas comment). A footer bar shows mono 'View on GitHub' (git-branch icon) and 'Install skill' (download icon).

A left-aligned header (acid mono '// the agent' eyebrow, Space Grotesk headline 'A design agent that thinks in components.', supporting paragraph), then a responsive 3-column (sm:2, lg:3) grid of six panel-gradient cards with #26262f borders and a card-hover lift that brightens the border to acid/40. Each card: a 44px rounded icon tile (acid/10 fill, acid/30 ring, acid line icon), an 18px Space Grotesk 600 title, and a zinc2 description. The six: Infinite canvas, Real code not mockups, Design-system aware, Drives your coding agent, Prompt library, Real-time multiplayer.

A two-column section (copy + mock) with a faint hero-glow. Copy (acid mono '// prompt library' eyebrow, Space Grotesk headline 'Start from a recipe that already works.', a paragraph, a 3-item check-circle list, and an acid 'Browse the library' arrow link). Mock: a rounded panel-gradient card with a browser-ish titlebar (three muted dots + a mono 'search prompts...' field with a magnifier) and a 2x2 grid of mini library cards, each a gradient thumbnail with a centered icon plus a title and a mono category line; one card (Landing page / featured) is acid-bordered and glowing.

A centered-header section (acid mono '// pricing' eyebrow, Space Grotesk headline 'Start free. Scale when you ship.', subcopy) above a 3-column (md) max-w-4xl card row, items-stretch. Free and Team are standard panel-gradient rounded-2xl cards with #26262f borders, hover lift, a $40 Space Grotesk price, an outlined button, and a 3-4 item acid-check feature list. The center Pro card is featured: acid/50 border, full acid glow shadow, a '-top' centered 'MOST POPULAR' acid pill, an acid 'Pro' label, $19/mo, a solid acid 'Start Pro' button, and a 4-item list.

A full-bleed bordered band with a top-anchored acid radial glow and grain, centered. A giant Space Grotesk headline 'Design, reimagined.' with 'Ship it today.' as acid gradient-text below, a short max-w-md paragraph, and a button row (solid acid 'Start building free' + outlined 'Talk to us' with an up-right arrow).

A bordered obsidian footer in the 1180px container. Top: a 5-region grid (1.5fr brand + four 1fr link columns Product/Resources/Company/Legal). Brand block: logo tile + wordmark, a one-line tagline, an 'All systems operational' status pill (pulsing acid dot in a bordered chip), and a social icon row (X, GitHub, Discord, YouTube) that recolor acid on hover. Link columns use Space Grotesk 600 headings and zinc3 link lists. A bottom hairline separates a mono legal row: '© 2026 Forge Labs, Inc. Built for people who ship.' and 'Made on an infinite canvas.'

special_ui_components.prompt: A solid acid-green #22e584 button with dark #06120b label text in Space Grotesk 600, carrying a combined shadow of a 1px acid ring plus a ~28px green drop; on hover it lifts -1px and the glow intensifies.

special_ui_components.description: The hero and workflow code mocks.
special_ui_components.prompt: A rounded-xl panel-gradient card with a #26262f border and a deep panel shadow; a titlebar with three macOS traffic-light dots (#ff5f57/#febc2e/#28c840) and a mono label; a mono body using the terminal syntax palette (acid keywords, #d6c98a strings, #7aa2ff numbers, #8b8b97 comments, #c4c4cf functions, #6b6b78 punctuation); the workflow variant adds a fixed line-number gutter.
An uppercase JetBrains Mono eyebrow prefixed with '// ', tracked ~0.22em, in acid/80, sitting above each section headline.
A rounded-lg 32px tile with an acid/10 fill, acid/40 ring, and a small green glow, holding a four-diamond glyph in acid, next to a Space Grotesk 700 'Forge' wordmark.
A bordered panel chip with a pulsing acid dot (with glow) and mono 'All systems operational' text.

structured.special_notes: Keep the accent strictly acid-green #22e584 (with #13c46d for depth); avoid the generic indigo/violet/blue SaaS gradient. Every surface is a layered near-black (#0a0a0f / #14141b / #1b1b24) with a single #26262f hairline for all borders and dividers. Code blocks must stay legible with the terminal syntax palette and real-looking generated code. Use the grain + acid radial glows sparingly (hero, CTA) so they read as light, not noise. Icons are thin 1.6-weight line icons (Phosphor-style) in acid or zinc. Responsive: the hero, workflow tabs, feature grid, product shot, and pricing all reflow gracefully from desktop to tablet to a single mobile column; the center nav collapses below lg. No em-dashes in any copy.
